European private law.

International organizations.

questions.question: What are the three most important things you would tell a UCPH student who is going to your host institution on exchange? *
questions.answer:
Get your housing as early as possible. 
Dont stress about the oral exams, since they are much easier than in UCPH.
If you are a student under age 25 you can get tickets to Colosseum and Forum Romanum for only 2 euros. Worth a visit.
